snippet.title: SX BEYOND — Official Trailer | Open World Survival Game
snippet.description:
SX BEYOND — Official Trailer

The world has fallen. Humanity is gone, and something far worse has taken its place.

SX BEYOND is an open-world survival game set on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Explore a dangerous world, gather resources, fight corrupted creatures and demons, build your shelter, discover the remains of a forgotten civilization, and uncover the truth behind the collapse.

Survive alone or with other players as you explore abandoned locations, face deadly enemies, and search for the evidence left behind by those who came before you.

⚔️ Explore. Survive. Rebuild. Discover the truth.

🎮 SX BEYOND is coming to Steam in Early Access.

Wishlist / Play on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5333880/SX_BEYOND/

Developed by Legendary Legion — a game created by one person.

#SXBEYOND #SurvivalGame #OpenWorld #IndieGame #Steam #Survival #Gaming
